rationale: The workflow already implements the applicable evidence-supported optimizations. (1) Dependency caching is present: setup-java@v4 with cache: maven caches ~/.m2/repository, and a separate actions@v4 step caches the Maven wrapper distribution (~/.m2/wrapper), so P-LIT-GHA-CACHE is contraindicated because an equivalent cache already exists. (2) Stale-run cancellation for pull requests is already implemented via the concurrency block with cancel-in-progress keyed by github.ref (refs/pull/N/merge), satisfying P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE's partition-by-workflow-and-PR requirement; push branches and tags are deliberately sha- or ref-keyed without cancellation to avoid dropping main/tag runs. (3) Explicit per-job timeouts already exist (30 min test, 20 min coverage) with documented justification, matching P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT. The remaining candidate, P-LIT-FAIL-FAST (setting fail-fast: true on the 14-cell JDK x OS matrix), is contraindicated: every matrix outcome is required for cross-platform/JDK coverage, and the workflow deliberately disables fail-fast to preserve full diagnostics; enabling it would cancel remaining lanes and reduce intended test coverage. No supported change adds benefit while preserving coverage.
